hero.title: Always Know What's Blocking Progress.
hero.description: HABOS continuously analyzes every task, dependency, and deadline to surface the critical path. You see bottlenecks before they become problems.

body: The project system uses AI analysis to continuously identify the critical path. GPT-4o examines all plan items, dependencies, and current status, then identifies bottlenecks and blocking chains. Critical path items automatically receive higher priority in the scheduling engine — when focus blocks fill, critical path tasks slot in first. Dependencies enforce topological ordering, so predecessor tasks are always scheduled before their dependents.

differentiator.headline: An AI per project that knows what's actually blocking you.
differentiator.subline: Not what's overdue — what's stopping the goal. Each project's AI reads the full context, spawns research, and surfaces the one thing to move next.

criticalPath.note: AI identified "Tile selection" as the bottleneck 3 days before the team noticed. Critical path items are auto-promoted to highest priority in your schedule.

bottlenecks.title: Bottlenecks found automatically
bottlenecks.description: AI examines all plan items, dependencies, and status. It sets critical_rank on items that form the blocking chain — and your calendar prioritizes them immediately.

dependencies.title: Dependencies enforced
dependencies.description: If a predecessor isn't complete, the dependent task is marked blocked and can't be started. No more working on the wrong thing.

connected.title: Every source connected
connected.description: Emails, meetings, voice notes, and documents are auto-tagged to projects. Ask "why is this behind?" and get a real answer.

without.heading: Without HABOS
without.description: Monday standup: "Any blockers?" Silence. Thursday: "Why isn't the tile installed?" "Oh, the samples never arrived." Three days lost.

with.heading: With HABOS
with.description: Tuesday morning: notification — "Tile selection is now the critical path bottleneck. Sample delivery is 2 days out. Recommend: escalate with supplier." Action taken same day.

cta.heading: Other project tools show you tasks. HABOS shows you what matters.
